d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

This role is critical in establishing the overall Revenue strategy for both Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort. You will be responsible for maximizing total revenue, optimizing pricing and distribution, and driving market positioning through data-led decision making, while aligning with brand standards and commercial objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in hotel management or finance.
2 years holding a Revenue Manager position at comparible hotel.
Familiar with the hotel operations, available technology (PMS & RMS) and all distributionchannels.
Understand the dynamics of regional & local markets, as well as local competitors and events.
Key Competencies Required; Coaching & Developing Others, Facilitating Change, Aligning Strategies into Results, Innovation, Problem Analysis and Decision Making.

d: The job holder will support the Finance Director in managing the finance analysis function for a specific business; this will be achieved by directing, supervising and coordinating team activity within the financial control function. This role combines both management/leadership and a hands-on work output.

The role of the function is to support the business in preparation of budgets, forecasting financials, perform meaningful analysis of financials, and assist operations in defining meaning KPIs for monitoring and improving performance and supporting business growth initiatives
Partner with business leaders ultimately supporting the achievement of financial business performance
Monitor and interpret financial performance, providing regular analysis and expert guidance to General Managers/Directors offering insight and recommendations to enhance business performance.
Lead the annual budgeting & forecasting exercise by integrating with key business stakeholders across functions.
Ensure that strategic plan, business plan and quarterly reviews are developed and submitted for corporate management review on a timely basis.
Play an important role in addressing major strategic issues that have a long-term impact through efficient budgeting & forecasting mechanisms.
Provide accurate information to management on a timely basis on key success factors of the business.
Review current systems, make recommendations for systems enhancement and participate in implementation of new systems.
Carryout detailed revenue enhancing and cost saving analysis eg. pricing, profitability, etc. based on discussions and validation by Director
Review capital expenditure models prepared by the team and FE function and manage administrative process of seeking internal approvals etc.
Manage key relationships within business like GM, GGM etc. and provide ad-hoc analysis at short notice.
Participate in evaluating new business opportunities, expansion etc. by building initial models
Direct and co-ordinate all activities of the financial control function
Lead, coach and develop a team of analysts.
4-8 years of post-qualification professional experience within finance, with at least 1 year as a Finance Manager in a multinational environment
Strong knowledge of financial and management accounting concepts coupled with excellent financial analytical capability.
Strong oral, written and presentation skills with the gravitas and presence to interact effectively with VP level stakeholders.
Ability to manage delivery of department through the staff in a timely fashion.
Strong talent development skills with the proven ability to coach and mentor diverse talent
Ability to influence and articulate point of view
Exposed to ERP and business intelligence systems.

The Mechanical Engineer (Trainer) is responsible for delivering technical training programs related to mechanical systems, maintenance practices, safety standards, and engineering operations. The role involves developing training materials, conducting classroom and practical sessions, assessing trainee competency, and supporting the continuous development of engineering and maintenance personnel.
q: Professional training certification (Train the Trainer, Instructional Techniques, or equivalent) is preferred.
Minimum 5-8 years of experience in mechanical maintenance, facilities management, industrial operations, or engineering services.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience delivering technical training programs.
r: li
Develop and deliver training programs for mechanical systems, equipment, and maintenance activities.
li
Conduct classroom, workshop, and on-the-job training sessions for technicians, supervisors, and engineers.
li
Prepare training manuals, presentations, assessments, and practical exercises.
li
Evaluate trainees' performance through tests, practical assessments, and competency evaluations.
li
Ensure training programs comply with industry standards, manufacturer guidelines, and company procedures.
li
Provide technical guidance on HVAC, pumps, compressors, mechanical equipment, plumbing systems, and rotating machinery.
li
Identify skill gaps and recommend development plans for employees.
li
Maintain training records, attendance reports, competency matrices, and certification documents.
li
Support the implementation of preventive and corrective maintenance best practices.
li
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with HSE regulations during training activities.
li
Coordinate with operations and maintenance teams to schedule and deliver technical training requirements.
li
Stay updated with new technologies, industry developments, and engineering best practices.
